summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K on 12 May 2026 under Rule 13a-16/15d-16, disclosing a TR-1 notification of major holdings. Fiera Capital Corporation crossed the 3% threshold on 24-Apr-2026, moving from 4.375% (6,933,553 voting rights) to 3.987% (5,986,659 voting rights), a passive ownership decrease below the UK notifiable threshold. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of a change in beneficial ownership, not an activist campaign, tender offer, or any other special-situation event. No board recommendation, transaction terms, or structural changes are involved. Watch for any subsequent filings if Fiera continues to reduce its stake.
